guardian.//pause_on_no_good_post_h: ARMED for the launch (the review's launch-configuration note; round 2): after this many hours without a good floor post of an Ethereum collection, the guardian pauses THAT collection's poster, so its holders burn at the frozen floor (never above the backing) instead of waiting for the 7-day escape. Since round 2 wash trading cannot stop posts; what still can is the runner handing in no listings, or fewer than three live ones. 6 h is the operator's to change (2 to 160)

eth_nft.//eth_rpc: custody is read on both. The operator's decision of 2026-09-27: Dwellir (the paid plan) first, replacing eth.drpc.org (its free tier refuses the scans, review round 3 D3-L-3); its key is NEVER written here: ${DWELLIR_API_KEY} is expanded from the monitor's environment at load and scrubbed from every alert and status line. xrpc.cl/eth is the second, independent and keyless (measured 2026-09-27: finalized tag, eth_getLogs over 500 and 2,001 blocks). The canister's evm_chains[1] must NOT carry the keyed URL (its install argument is published with every timelock proposal): it keeps a keyless pair (audit 2026-09-27-nft B-M-6; flagged for the round-3 fixer)

The loader refuses price_refs anywhere the launch file does not decide it, and golive-check --monitor-config again

//cycles: go-live (docs/v7/golive-runbook.md §6; docs/v7/dormant-collections.md §7, §11): the buyer's burn-rate page (monitor/src/watcher.mjs burnCheck). SEV2 under 7 days of cycles at the rate measured over the last 24 h, SEV1 (persistent) under 2 days; SEV2 when the rate is above 10 T a day (the launch balance keeps one collection awake: about 2.8 T a day; raise this to about 1.5 x (0.3 + 2.5 x effective_max_active) T as top-ups raise the limit) or the balance under 12 T (the reserve: 8 T, the canister's scan floor, plus one collection's 3 T exit reserve). Separately the Ethereum NFT checker pages eth-capacity-short when the balance keeps fewer collections awake than hold positions (/status eth_capacity shows effective_max_active and the wake headroom). On a 34-node subnet multiply burn_warn_t_per_day by 2.6
